razonamiento: The architecture represents an event-driven transaction processing and categorization pipeline. Visual reading contains seven components: two Kinesis streams, two Lambda functions, two RDS databases, and an SQS queue. Narration walks through this exact sequence: an update event in Kinesis triggers a lean Lambda, which queries transaction history from RDS and batches records into SQS; SQS feeds a second Lambda executing Antler-compiled categorization rules, which writes categorized results to a second RDS and publishes results to an egress Kinesis stream. Background mentions of 'another service' and 'app' were omitted as external context without drawn boxes or specific service identities. Deployment tools Jenkins and CloudFormation were excluded per Rule 7. All 11 drawn directional lines on the whiteboard (including query/ack returns) are faithfully preserved as edges.
